episodes.title: Mili 14 ya waathiriwa wa mauaji ya Kwa Binzaro Shakahola yatolewa kwa mazishi
episodes.description:
Serikali imeachilia mili minane ya waathiriwa wa mauaji ya Kwa Binzaro-Shakahola ambayo imekuwa ikihifadhiwa kwenye chumba cha kuhifadhi maiti cha hospitali ya Malindi, kaunti ya Kilifi kwa familia zao ili izikwe. Mtaalamu wa serikali wa uchunguzi wa mili Dkt Richard Njoroge anasema mili hiyo ni miongoni mwa waathiriwa 14 waliotambuliwa kupitia uchunguzi wa chembechembe za msimbojeni za mili 53 na vipande vya mili 44 vilivyofukuliwa kutoka kaburi la pamoja kwenye msitu wa Shakahola.

episodes.title: Bodies of 8 Kwa Binzaro-Shakahola massacre victims released to families for burial
episodes.description:
The government has released 8 bodies of victims of the Kwa Binzaro-Shakahola massacre that had been preserved at the Malindi Sub-County Hospital mortuary in Kilifi County to their families for burial. Government Pathologist Dr Richard Njoroge says the bodies are among  14 victims positively identified through the DNA  testing out of 53 bodies and 44 body parts exhumed from shallow graves in the forest. He further called on more families to provide samples for DNA testing to identify the remaining victims.

episodes.title: Shakahola victims’ families given 21 days to collect unclaimed remains
episodes.description:
Families and relatives of victims of the Shakahola massacre whose remains have not yet been claimed have been given 21 days notice to collect them from the Malindi Sub-County Hospital in Kilifi County. During an inspection tour of the facility by a Joint Senate Committee, Kilifi County Executive Committee Member for Health Services, Peter Mwarogo, told the Senators that 443 bodies and body parts recovered from Shakahola Forest are preserved at the facility and if no claim is made, mass interment will be on land secured near the site of the tragedy

episodes.title: Mili 443 ya Shakahola bado haijachukuliwa na familia kwa maziko
episodes.description:
Familia na jamaa za waathiriwa wa matukio ya Shakahola ambao hawajachukua miili ya wapendwa wao kwa maziko, wamepewa muda wa siku 21 kuichukua kutoka hospitali ya kaunti ndogo ya Malindi. Wakati wa ziara ya kamati ya seneti kuhusu afya katika hospitali hiyo,  afisa mkuu wa idara ya afya katika kaunti ya Kilifi Peter Mwarogo, aliwaambia maseneta kuwa miili  443 iliyopatikana katika msitu wa Shakahola, bado iko kwenye chumba cha kuhifadhi maiti cha hospitali hiyo, na kwamba iwapo jamaa za wathiriwa hawataichukua katika muda huo, mazishi ya pamoja yataandaliwa katika eneo litakalotengwa

episodes.title: Families begin to bury their loved ones who died in the Shakahola tragedy
episodes.description:
Families of those who died in the Shakahola tragedy have begun burying their loved ones.Among them is a family from Butere in Kakamega County, which lost six members in the incident. George Keye Okaka received the bodies of his wife and three children after months of waiting. Okaka says his wife joined Paul Makenzi’s sect in 2019, hoping to find spiritual guidance, but instead, it led to tragedy. He is still waiting for the identification of his two remaining children. Sixteen bodies have been released to families as the identification and burial process continues.

episodes.title: 2 church faithful die in Migori, 57 others rescued during standoff with security officers
episodes.description:
At least two bodies have been retrieved and 57 people rescued from a church compound in Opapo, Rongo, Migori County, following a violent standoff between church members and security officers. The confrontation arose at Melkio St Joseph Missions of Messiah Africa Church hit the headlines recently after a GSU officer died and was buried in the church compound.
